messages:
Roxanne (PM): Heads-up — we need to lock prioritization for inference perf work next quarter. Customer asks, infra debt, and a couple platform bets all compete. Proposing a quick RICE check + sequencing call. Opinions?

Alex Chen: +1. My instincts: prioritize quick wins that reduce token cost and p99, then move to platform-level kernel/quant work.

Priya Rao: CFO is pushing for unit cost reductions this quarter. If we can show 20–30% token/cost savings with low risk, that helps renewals. But customers also demand p99 latency.

Jamal Ortiz: Suggest we make decisions experimental: canary 10% traffic for 2 weeks, measure latency, cost delta, and error/backoff rates. That gives datapoints for RICE inputs.

Ivy Nguyen: Add a quality gate: run held promptset evals on every change. Launch only if acceptance >= 95% and no regressions on top-10 customers.

Alex Chen: Draft RICE numbers for quick compare (super rough):

```
Feature | Reach (monthly reqs) | Impact (1-5) | Confidence | Effort (dev-weeks) | RICE score
prefix cache | 30k | 4 | 0.8 | 2 | 480
batching tweaks | 20k | 3 | 0.7 | 3 | 140
endpoint throttles | 15k | 2 | 0.9 | 1 | 270
kv-quant prototype | 10k | 5 | 0.5 | 8 | 31.25
```

Alex Chen: Based on that, wave 1 = prefix cache + endpoint throttles (fast). Wave 2 = batching + autoscale policy. Wave 3 = kv/quant exploration (long lead).

Priya Rao: Can we convert RICE to expected $ delta? Even ballpark monthly savings helps prioritization. I can run numbers if you give cost-per-token and expected token delta.

Jamal Ortiz: I'll own the canary plan and infra hooks. Quick checklist: config flag, 10% traffic router, metrics dashboard (latency, tokens, errors), rollback playbook.

Ivy Nguyen: I'll build the eval job and sample prompts. Need ownership for customer-specific regressions — tag top customers and run the regression suite on them.

Eng-Bot: :bar_chart: Poll posted: "Which first-wave item do you want to ship first?" Results: prefix cache 5, endpoint throttles 2, batching 1.

Roxanne (PM): Thanks — looks like consensus. Decision: ship wave 1 (prefix cache + endpoint throttles) as a canary to 10% traffic, 2-week experiment. Wave 2 (batching + autoscale) queued for next sprint. Wave 3 (kv/quant) becomes research project with OKR milestone.

Roxanne (PM): Action items (owner — due EOW): Alex Chen — implementation plan + PR list; Jamal Ortiz — canary infra config + dashboard; Ivy Nguyen — eval suite + acceptance thresholds; Priya Rao — cost impact calc for finance; Roxanne — update roadmap and notify sales. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: I'll drop a short RFC with timelines and risks by EOD.

Priya Rao: I'll mock $ delta table and share with finance.

Jamal Ortiz: Setting up the router flag this afternoon.

Ivy Nguyen: Starting eval job and will attach the baseline results to the RFC.

Roxanne (PM): Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene after data from the canary to finalize wave 2 sequencing.
